subject: PE
title: Physical Education 6
description: Grade 6 PE emphasizes working cooperatively toward common goals while refining skills in invasion, net/wall, striking/fielding, rhythmic and individual activities. Students learn fitness concepts (FITT, heart-rate zones, components of health-related fitness), take FITNESSGRAM-style baseline and end-of-year assessments, and build a personal fitness plan. Lessons are designed for a backyard, park or co-op with minimal equipment; every day includes a warm-up and at least 20 minutes of moderate-to-vigorous activity.
framework: Physical Education Model Content Standards for California Public Schools (Grade 6); 2009 CA Physical Education Framework

standards.PE-6.1.1: Throw, kick and strike objects with accuracy and appropriate force using mature form in cooperative and individual activities.
standards.PE-6.1.2: Combine locomotor, non-locomotor and manipulative skills to work cooperatively toward a common goal.
standards.PE-6.1.3: Perform rhythmic patterns and folk, line and cooperative dances with accuracy and coordination.
standards.PE-6.1.4: Demonstrate mature technique for dribbling, passing, volleying, setting and receiving in game settings.
standards.PE-6.2.1: Explain how to modify skills and strategies to work effectively with a partner or team.
standards.PE-6.2.2: Use practice, feedback and critical elements to analyze and improve one's own and others' skill performance.
standards.PE-6.2.3: Explain and apply basic offensive and defensive strategies in cooperative, invasion, net and fielding games.
standards.PE-6.3.1: Participate in moderate to vigorous physical activity a minimum of four days each week, and track activity.
standards.PE-6.3.2: Assess aerobic capacity, muscular strength and endurance, flexibility and body composition using a standard fitness test.
standards.PE-6.3.3: Set and monitor short- and long-term goals to improve health-related fitness.
standards.PE-6.4.1: Explain and apply the FITT principles (frequency, intensity, time, type) to a personal fitness plan.
standards.PE-6.4.2: Measure heart rate and explain target heart-rate zones and recovery.
standards.PE-6.4.3: Explain the purpose of warm-up and cool-down, safe practices, hydration and nutrition for activity.
standards.PE-6.5.1: Cooperate with others, communicate positively and accept roles to accomplish a group goal.
standards.PE-6.5.2: Demonstrate responsible behavior, sportsmanship and conflict-resolution skills during activity.
standards.PE-6.5.3: Include and encourage others of different skill levels and abilities.

units.title: Fitness Baseline and Goal Setting
units.big_idea: Knowing your current fitness lets you set meaningful goals and train safely.

units.title: Cooperative Challenges and Team Building
units.big_idea: Teams succeed when members communicate, plan together and include everyone.

units.title: Invasion Games: Soccer and Ultimate
units.big_idea: Invasion games share strategies: create space on offense, deny space on defense.

units.title: Invasion Games: Basketball
units.big_idea: Ball control, passing and spacing make team offense effective.

units.title: Net and Wall Games: Volleyball and Badminton
units.big_idea: Net games reward controlled contacts and placing the object where opponents are not.

units.title: Striking and Fielding: Softball and Kickball
units.big_idea: Fielding teams cooperate to prevent runs; batters aim to place the ball.

units.title: Rhythms and Dance
units.big_idea: Dance builds coordination and fitness and expresses culture.

units.title: Individual Activities: Track, Jump Rope and Orienteering
units.big_idea: Individual activities let you measure personal progress and can be done for a lifetime.

units.title: Personal Fitness Plan and Reassessment
units.big_idea: Applying FITT principles to a personal plan improves fitness you can measure.

objectives: Perform a dynamic warm-up and cool-down
Measure resting and active heart rate

days.title: Dynamic warm-up
days.work: Learn a 10-move dynamic warm-up (high knees, butt kicks, carioca, arm circles) and a static-stretch cool-down.

days.title: Finding your pulse
days.work: Find your carotid and radial pulse, measure resting heart rate for 15 seconds x 4, and record it.

days.title: Heart rate response
days.work: Measure heart rate after walking, jogging and sprinting for 1 minute each and graph the results.

days.title: Safety and hydration
days.work: Play a tag game, then discuss heat safety, hydration and proper shoes; set a daily water goal.

days.title: Check
days.work: Lead the warm-up yourself and complete a short quiz on heart rate and warm-up purpose.

weeks.topic: Fitness testing: aerobic capacity and strength
materials: PACER audio (free online) or measured 20 m course

days.title: PACER or mile
days.work: Complete the 20-meter PACER test or a timed one-mile run/walk and record laps or time.

days.title: Curl-ups
days.work: Learn correct curl-up form and complete the cadence curl-up test.

days.title: Push-ups
days.work: Learn 90-degree push-up form and complete the cadence push-up test.

days.title: Active recovery
days.work: Play a low-intensity game (frisbee catch) and record test results in a fitness log.

days.title: Check
days.work: Compare your results with the Healthy Fitness Zone charts for your age.

weeks.topic: Fitness testing: flexibility and goal setting

days.title: Sit-and-reach
days.work: Complete the back-saver sit-and-reach test on both legs.

days.title: Trunk lift
days.work: Complete the trunk-lift test and learn safe back-strengthening exercises.

days.title: Components of fitness
days.work: Learn the five components of health-related fitness and match each test to a component; play a circuit game.

days.title: SMART goals
days.work: Write two SMART goals based on your baseline results.

days.title: Check
days.work: Share goals with a parent and do a 20-minute circuit targeting your goal areas.

objectives: Communicate clearly to solve group problems

days.title: Blindfold maze
days.work: Guide a blindfolded partner through a cone maze using only verbal directions, then switch.

days.title: Hula hoop pass
days.work: Pass a hula hoop around a hand-holding circle without letting go; time and improve.

days.title: Human knot
days.work: Untangle a human knot with family or co-op members and discuss communication strategies.

days.title: Encouragement game
days.work: Play a relay where teams earn points for encouraging words as well as speed.

days.title: Reflect
days.work: Write about one way you helped your team and one way to improve.

objectives: Plan and test strategies as a group

days.title: Lava river
days.work: Cross a 'lava river' using a limited number of poly spots as a group, planning before trying.

days.title: Group juggle
days.work: Pass several balls in a set pattern around a circle and add balls as success grows.

days.title: Keep it up
days.work: Keep a balloon or beach ball in the air as long as possible with each person touching it in order.

days.title: Modify for all
days.work: Redesign one challenge so a person using a wheelchair or with limited vision could fully take part.

days.title: Reflect
days.work: Record your group's best times and explain which strategy change helped most.

days.title: Sheet games
days.work: Play bedsheet or parachute games (popcorn, mushroom) that require timing together.

days.title: Cooperative tag
days.work: Play 'everybody's it' and 'freeze tag with rescue' and track steps.

days.title: Team circuit
days.work: Complete a partner fitness circuit where partners must sync reps.

days.title: Design a game
days.work: Design a cooperative game with rules and teach it to family members.

days.title: Check
days.work: Play your designed game and evaluate it for activity level and inclusion.

objectives: Dribble with control using inside and outside of foot
Pass accurately with the inside of the foot

days.title: Dribbling
days.work: Dribble through a cone course using inside, outside and sole touches.

days.title: Passing
days.work: Practice inside-foot passes with a partner or against a wall at 5 and 10 meters.

days.title: Receiving
days.work: Trap balls with the inside of the foot and thigh, then pass in one motion.

days.title: Small-sided game
days.work: Play 2v1 keep-away to practice passing into open space.

days.title: Skill check
days.work: Complete a skill check: 10 passes through a 1-meter cone gate and a timed dribble course.

objectives: Apply spacing and support in small games

days.title: Shooting
days.work: Practice instep shots at a target from 10 meters, aiming for the corners.

days.title: Offensive spacing
days.work: Learn to create passing triangles and move to open space in a 3v1 drill.

days.title: Defense
days.work: Practice defensive stance, jockeying and staying goal-side.

days.title: Game day
days.work: Play small-sided soccer, rotating positions and practicing fair play.

days.title: Reflect
days.work: Write about one offensive and one defensive strategy you used.

weeks.topic: Ultimate: throwing and catching a disc
objectives: Catch with pancake and rim catches

days.title: Backhand
days.work: Practice backhand throws to a partner, focusing on a flat release.

days.title: Catching
days.work: Practice pancake and rim catches at different heights.

days.title: Forehand
days.work: Learn the forehand (flick) throw and practice 30 throws.

days.title: Pivot and pass
days.work: Practice pivoting to avoid a marker and passing to a moving receiver.

days.title: Skill check
days.work: Complete 10 backhand throws to a target 10 meters away and record successes.

weeks.topic: Ultimate: game play and Spirit of the Game
objectives: Play ultimate using rules and self-officiating

days.title: Rules
days.work: Learn ultimate rules and practice a stall count while marking.

days.title: Cutting
days.work: Practice cuts to get open and the 'give and go'.

days.title: Game
days.work: Play ultimate, resolving calls through Spirit of the Game discussion.

days.title: Compare strategies
days.work: Compare soccer and ultimate strategies on a chart and play a modified game.

days.title: Unit check
days.work: Take a quiz on invasion strategies and self-assess sportsmanship.

days.title: Ball handling
days.work: Complete ball-handling drills (around the waist, figure 8, finger taps).

days.title: Dribbling
days.work: Practice control and speed dribbles with each hand through cones.

days.title: Crossover
days.work: Learn the crossover dribble and practice it against a partner defender.

days.title: Peer feedback
days.work: Use a critical-elements checklist to give a partner feedback on dribbling.

days.title: Skill check
days.work: Complete a timed dribble course with both hands.

objectives: Execute chest, bounce and overhead passes

days.title: Passing
days.work: Practice chest, bounce and overhead passes to a wall target, 20 each.

days.title: Shooting form
days.work: Practice form shooting close to the hoop using BEEF (balance, eyes, elbow, follow-through).

days.title: Layups
days.work: Practice right- and left-hand layups with the correct footwork.

days.title: Video analysis
days.work: Record your shot, compare it with the BEEF checklist and set a correction goal.

days.title: Skill check
days.work: Shoot 10 shots from 3 spots and record your percentage.

days.title: Give-and-go
days.work: Practice the give-and-go with a partner and cut to the basket.

days.title: Defense
days.work: Practice defensive slides and staying between your player and the basket.

days.title: Rebounding
days.work: Practice boxing out and rebounding in a 1v1 drill.

days.title: 2v2 games
days.work: Play 2v2 half-court games applying offensive and defensive strategies.

days.title: Reflect
days.work: Diagram one play you used and explain why it worked.

days.title: Rules
days.work: Learn traveling, double dribble and foul calls and practice referee signals.

days.title: 3v3 game
days.work: Play 3v3 games, rotating a student referee.

days.title: Knockout and HORSE
days.work: Play shooting games to practice under pressure.

days.title: Tournament
days.work: Hold a mini-tournament with family or co-op, focusing on sportsmanship.

days.title: Unit check
days.work: Take a basketball rules quiz and redo the shooting check to compare with week 12.

days.title: Ready position
days.work: Learn ready position and footwork; practice forearm passes off a self-toss.

days.title: Partner bumping
days.work: Bump with a partner and count consecutive passes.

days.title: Setting
days.work: Learn the overhead set with a triangle hand shape and set to yourself 20 times.

days.title: Pass to set
days.work: Practice pass-to-set sequences with a partner.

days.title: Skill check
days.work: Complete 10 forearm passes to a target zone and record successes.

days.title: Underhand serve
days.work: Practice underhand serves over the net from 6 and then 9 meters.

days.title: Overhand serve
days.work: Learn the overhand serve toss and contact.

days.title: Cooperative rally
days.work: Play a cooperative rally game aiming for 3 contacts per side.

days.title: Game play
days.work: Play modified volleyball with rotation and placement strategy.

days.title: Reflect
days.work: Write about where to place the ball to win points and why.

objectives: Perform the clear and drop shot

days.title: Grip and serve
days.work: Learn the handshake grip and practice short and long serves.

days.title: Forehand and backhand
days.work: Rally with forehand and backhand strokes with a partner.

days.title: Clear and drop
days.work: Practice clears to the back and drop shots near the net.

days.title: Singles game
days.work: Play singles badminton games using placement strategy.

days.title: Skill check
days.work: Count longest rally and number of successful clears out of 10.

weeks.topic: Net games tournament and mid-year check

days.title: Four square and paddle games
days.work: Play four square and paddle games to practice placement.

days.title: Mid-year fitness check
days.work: Retake the PACER or mile and the push-up test and compare to baseline.

days.title: Tournament day 1
days.work: Play a family volleyball or badminton tournament round.

days.title: Tournament day 2
days.work: Play final rounds and practice handshakes and positive comments.

days.title: Goal check
days.work: Update your SMART goals based on mid-year results.

weeks.assessment: Mid-year fitness comparison and updated goals.

objectives: Throw overhand with hip and shoulder rotation
Field ground balls and fly balls

days.title: Overhand throw
days.work: Practice the overhand throw with step, hip rotation and follow-through at a target.

days.title: Ground balls
days.work: Field 30 ground balls using alligator hands and throw to a target.

days.title: Fly balls
days.work: Catch fly balls with two hands above the head, calling 'mine'.

days.title: Crow hop
days.work: Learn the crow hop to throw farther and measure distance.

days.title: Skill check
days.work: Throw 10 balls at a target from 15 meters and record accuracy.

days.title: Stance and grip
days.work: Learn batting stance and grip and practice dry swings.

days.title: Tee hitting
days.work: Hit 30 whiffle balls off a tee aiming for line drives.

days.title: Soft toss
days.work: Hit soft-tossed balls from a partner.

days.title: Placement
days.work: Practice hitting to left, center and right field targets.

days.title: Skill check
days.work: Hit 10 pitched balls and record contacts.

days.title: Base running
days.work: Practice running through first base and rounding bases.

days.title: Outs
days.work: Practice force outs and tag outs in a fielding drill.

days.title: Kickball game
days.work: Play kickball applying fielding positions.

days.title: Relay throws
days.work: Practice relay throws from the outfield through a cutoff.

days.title: Reflect
days.work: Explain where fielders should throw with a runner on first and why.

objectives: Apply striking and fielding skills in games

days.title: Positions
days.work: Learn infield and outfield positions and backing-up responsibilities.

days.title: Game 1
days.work: Play a modified softball game with every player batting each inning.

days.title: Game 2
days.work: Play again, rotating positions.

days.title: Home run derby
days.work: Hold a placement derby where points depend on hitting target zones.

days.title: Unit check
days.work: Take a quiz on striking and fielding rules and strategies.

days.title: Finding the beat
days.work: Step to the beat of songs at different tempos and count 8-counts.

days.title: Basic steps
days.work: Learn grapevine, step-touch, pivot turn and kick-ball-change.

days.title: Line dance
days.work: Learn the Cha Cha Slide or Cupid Shuffle with correct counts.

days.title: Heart rate
days.work: Dance for 10 minutes continuously and check heart rate.

days.title: Check
days.work: Perform the line dance from memory for a family member.

weeks.topic: Folk dances from around the world
materials: music for Mayim Mayim, Virginia Reel, Tinikling

days.title: Mayim Mayim
days.work: Learn the Israeli circle dance Mayim Mayim.

days.title: Virginia Reel
days.work: Learn the Virginia Reel with partners.

days.title: Tinikling
days.work: Learn Tinikling (Philippines) steps using jump ropes on the ground in place of poles.

days.title: Practice
days.work: Practice all three dances and discuss where each comes from.

days.title: Check
days.work: Perform one folk dance for an audience.

objectives: Choreograph a dance that raises heart rate

days.title: Plan
days.work: Choose music and plan a 2-minute routine using at least six steps learned.

days.title: Build
days.work: Build the routine in 8-counts and write it down.

days.title: Practice
days.work: Practice the routine and check heart rate to confirm moderate-to-vigorous intensity.

days.title: Teach
days.work: Teach your routine to family members.

days.title: Perform
days.work: Perform the routine together and evaluate with a rubric.

objectives: Use proper sprint form and starts

days.title: Sprint form
days.work: Practice sprint drills (A-skips, high knees, arm drive).

days.title: Starts
days.work: Practice standing and three-point starts and time 40-meter dashes.

days.title: Baton exchange
days.work: Practice upsweep baton exchanges in an exchange zone.

days.title: Relay races
days.work: Run shuttle and 4x50 m relays.

days.title: Check
days.work: Time a final 50 m sprint and compare with day 2.

objectives: Use heart rate to monitor intensity

days.title: Target heart rate
days.work: Calculate your target heart-rate zone and check it during a 10-minute jog.

days.title: Pacing
days.work: Run four laps trying to keep each lap within 5 seconds of the others.

days.title: Interval run
days.work: Alternate 1 minute fast and 1 minute easy for 16 minutes.

days.title: Long run
days.work: Run or run-walk 20 continuous minutes and record distance.

days.title: Check
days.work: Run a timed mile and compare with baseline.

objectives: Perform standing long jump and high jump technique

days.title: Standing long jump
days.work: Practice arm swing and two-foot takeoff; measure three jumps.

days.title: Running long jump
days.work: Practice approach run and one-foot takeoff into grass or sand.

days.title: Scissor high jump
days.work: Practice the scissor-kick high jump over a pool noodle.

days.title: Softball throw
days.work: Throw for distance using a step-and-throw and measure the best of three.

days.title: Mini track meet
days.work: Hold a family track meet with sprint, jump and throw events.

objectives: Perform basic and advanced jump rope skills

days.title: Basic skills
days.work: Practice basic bounce, alternate foot step and skier for 1-minute intervals.

days.title: Tricks
days.work: Learn criss-cross and side swing; attempt double unders.

days.title: Endurance
days.work: Jump in 30-second intervals for 10 rounds and record total jumps.

days.title: Routine
days.work: Create a 1-minute jump rope routine with at least five skills.

days.title: Check
days.work: Perform your routine and count jumps in 1 minute.

objectives: Read a map and use a compass

days.title: Map reading
days.work: Draw a map of your yard or a park with a legend and north arrow.

days.title: Compass
days.work: Learn to take a bearing and walk to a target 20 paces away.

days.title: Score-O
days.work: Find as many control points as possible in 20 minutes on a parent-made course.

days.title: Design a course
days.work: Design an orienteering course for a family member.

days.title: Check
days.work: Complete a timed orienteering course and reflect on navigation strategy.

objectives: Apply FITT to each fitness component

days.title: FITT
days.work: Learn the FITT principle and identify FITT in three sample workouts.

days.title: Cardio workout
days.work: Complete a cardio workout and write its FITT.

days.title: Strength workout
days.work: Complete a body-weight strength circuit (squats, lunges, planks, push-ups) and write its FITT.

days.title: Flexibility workout
days.work: Complete a yoga-based flexibility session and write its FITT.

days.title: Check
days.work: Quiz on FITT and the principle of overload.

days.title: Review data
days.work: Review baseline and mid-year scores to choose focus areas.

days.title: Write plan
days.work: Write a 4-week plan with FITT for cardio, strength and flexibility.

days.title: Week 1 workout
days.work: Complete day 1 of your plan and log it.

days.title: Nutrition and rest
days.work: Add hydration, nutrition and sleep goals to your plan and complete day 2.

days.title: Check
days.work: Complete day 3 and have a parent sign off on the plan.

objectives: Follow and log a personal plan

days.title: Cardio day
days.work: Complete your plan's cardio workout and record heart rate.

days.title: Strength day
days.work: Complete your strength workout with progression (add reps or sets).

days.title: Active play
days.work: Play a favorite sport from the year for 30 minutes.

days.title: Flexibility day
days.work: Complete your flexibility workout and a sit-and-reach check.

days.title: Log review
days.work: Review your log and rate exertion for each day.

days.title: Cardio intervals
days.work: Complete interval training with increased intensity.

days.title: Strength
days.work: Complete strength workout and test max push-ups in 1 minute.

days.title: Team game
days.work: Play a team game (ultimate or soccer) with family or co-op.

days.title: Flexibility and yoga
days.work: Complete a 20-minute yoga flow.

days.title: Adjust
days.work: Adjust next week's plan based on results and how you felt.

days.title: PACER or mile
days.work: Retake the PACER or mile run.

days.title: Curl-ups and push-ups
days.work: Retake curl-up and push-up tests.

days.title: Flexibility
days.work: Retake sit-and-reach and trunk-lift tests.

days.title: Analyze
days.work: Graph baseline, mid-year and final scores and check whether goals were met.

days.title: Celebrate
days.work: Play a favorite game and share one fitness accomplishment.

weeks.topic: Field day and lifetime activity goals
objectives: Demonstrate skills and sportsmanship in field day events

days.title: Plan field day
days.work: Plan a family or co-op field day with stations from each unit.

days.title: Field day
days.work: Run the field day, leading stations and encouraging others.

days.title: Reflection
days.work: Write a reflection on your favorite unit and biggest improvement.

days.title: Summer plan
days.work: Write a summer activity plan with at least 60 minutes of activity per day.

days.title: Final check
days.work: Complete a year-end quiz on fitness concepts and sportsmanship.

weeks.assessment: Year-end quiz and summer activity plan.
